messages.content: You are a helpful assistant with access to tools. Complete the user's request by calling the available tools as needed, then reply to the user.

I need to create a new workout plan. Let's call it 'Summer Shred 2024' for user 'user_456'. My goal is muscle gain, I'm an intermediate level, and I can work out 4 days a week. After that, I want to add 'Barbell Squats' with 4 sets and 8 reps to the first day of this new plan. Finally, log a session for 'user_456' on that same plan and day for today, lasting 60 minutes and burning 400 calories.
{"exercise_id": "ex_1234", "message": "Exercise 'Barbell Squats' added to day_1 of plan_7890."}

{"session_id": "session_5678", "message": "Workout session logged successfully for plan_7890, day_1. Find coffee shops within 2000 meters of latitude 34.0522, longitude -118.2437, returning up to 5 results."}

function.name: create_custom_workout_plan
function.description: Creates a new personalized workout plan for a user based on their goals, fitness level, and available equipment. This tool allows for highly customized plan generation.

user_id.description: The unique identifier of the user creating the workout plan.

plan_name.description: A descriptive name for the new workout plan.

goal.description: The primary fitness goal for the plan (e.g., 'muscle_gain', 'weight_loss', 'endurance', 'strength').

days_per_week.description: The number of days per week the user intends to work out.

equipment_available.description: A comma-separated list of equipment the user has access to (e.g., 'dumbbells,resistance_bands,barbell').

function.name: get_user_workout_plans
function.description: Retrieves a list of all workout plans associated with a specific user. This includes both custom and pre-built plans assigned to them.

user_id.description: The unique identifier of the user whose workout plans are to be retrieved.

include_archived.description: If true, archived plans will also be returned. Defaults to false.

function.name: update_workout_plan_status
function.description: Updates the status of an existing workout plan for a user. This can be used to activate, pause, complete, or archive a plan.

user_id.description: The unique identifier of the user who owns the workout plan.

plan_id.description: The unique identifier of the workout plan to be updated.

new_status.description: The new status for the workout plan (e.g., 'active', 'paused', 'completed', 'archived').

completion_date.description: Optional: Date when the plan was completed, if applicable (YYYY-MM-DD format).

function.name: add_exercise_to_workout
function.description: Adds a specific exercise with its details (sets, reps, weight) to a particular workout within an existing workout plan. This allows for dynamic modification of daily routines.

plan_id.description: The unique identifier of the workout plan.

workout_day_id.description: The unique identifier of the specific workout day within the plan (e.g., 'day_1', 'monday_workout').

exercise_name.description: The name of the exercise to add (e.g., 'Squats', 'Bench Press').

sets.description: The number of sets for the exercise.

reps.description: The number of repetitions per set.

weight_kg.description: The weight in kilograms for the exercise, if applicable.

function.name: log_workout_session
function.description: Records the completion and details of a user's workout session for a given plan and day. This tracks progress and adherence.

user_id.description: The unique identifier of the user logging the session.

plan_id.description: The unique identifier of the workout plan the session belongs to.

workout_day_id.description: The unique identifier of the specific workout day that was completed.

session_date.description: The date the workout session was completed (YYYY-MM-DD format).

duration_minutes.description: The total duration of the workout session in minutes.

calories_burned.description: The estimated number of calories burned during the session.

function.name: search_exercises_by_muscle_group
function.description: Searches for available exercises that target a specific muscle group. This helps users find alternative exercises or build custom workouts.

muscle_group.description: The primary muscle group to search for (e.g., 'chest', 'back', 'legs', 'shoulders', 'biceps', 'triceps', 'abs').

equipment_required.description: Optional: A comma-separated list of required equipment to filter exercises (e.g., 'dumbbell', 'barbell', 'bodyweight').

difficulty_level.description: Optional: Filter exercises by difficulty level (e.g., 'beginner', 'intermediate', 'advanced').

limit.description: The maximum number of exercises to return. Defaults to 10.

function.name: get_current_location
function.description: Retrieves the current geographical location (latitude and longitude) of the user's device or a specified reference point. This tool is useful for determining 'where am I?' or for setting a starting point for navigation.

accuracy.description: Desired accuracy level for the location, e.g., 'high', 'medium', 'low'. Higher accuracy might take longer.

timeout_seconds.description: Maximum time in seconds to wait for a location fix.

function.name: search_points_of_interest
function.description: Searches for points of interest (POIs) like restaurants, parks, or shops near a specified location or within a given area. Results can be filtered by category or keywords.

query.description: Keywords or category to search for, e.g., 'coffee shops', 'museums', 'gas station'.

latitude.description: Latitude of the center point for the search.

longitude.description: Longitude of the center point for the search.

radius_meters.description: Search radius in meters from the center point.

max_results.description: Maximum number of results to return.

open_now.description: If true, only return POIs that are currently open.

function.name: get_route_directions
function.description: Calculates the optimal route and provides step-by-step directions between two or more locations. Supports various travel modes.

avoid_tolls.description: If true, the route will try to avoid toll roads.

function.name: report_traffic_incident
function.description: Allows users to report a traffic incident (e.g., accident, road closure, congestion) at a specific location, helping to update real-time traffic data.

description.description: Optional brief description of the incident.

function.name: get_traffic_status
function.description: Retrieves real-time traffic conditions for a specified area or along a given route. Provides information on congestion levels.

center_latitude.description: Latitude of the center point for traffic status inquiry.

center_longitude.description: Longitude of the center point for traffic status inquiry.

radius_meters.description: Radius in meters around the center point to get traffic status for.

road_name.description: Optional: Specific road name to get traffic status for.

payload: Find coffee shops within 2000 meters of latitude 34.0522, longitude -118.2437, returning up to 5 results.
